title: Nnabata Ụwa
intro: N'oge nnukwu ọnwụnwa, e nyere onye a ma ama nnukwu ihe onwunwe n'ụwa, nke bụ ule ekele na ịdị umeala n'obi. Njem onye a bụ ihe mmụta dị omimi banyere ọdịdị ihe onwunwe na-adịghị agwụ agwụ na ihe ga-esi na mpako pụta. Chọpụta onye bụ mkpụrụ obi a nke akụkọ ya dị n'ala dị n'okpuru anyị pụta.
clues: Ebi m n'etiti ndị onye ozi ukwu na-edu.
Allah nyere m nnukwu akụnụba nke na mkpịsị ugodi nke akụ m bụ ibu arọ nye ọtụtụ ndị siri ike.
Ndị m, ebe ha maara akụnụba m, gwara m ka m jiri ihe Allah nyere m chọọ ebe obibi nke ndụ ebighị ebi, ka m ghara ichefu òkè m n'ụwa, ka m meekwa ihe ọma dịka Allah mere m.
Ekwuru m n'ụzọ mpako na e ji ihe ọmụma na mgbalị m nweta nnukwu akụnụba m, na-ajụkwa amara Chineke ọ bụla.
Mgbe a gwara m ka m nye onyinye ma ọ bụ nabata amara Chineke, ekwere m na ihe onwunwe m bụ nke m.
N'ihi oke mpako na mmegbu m, Allah nyere iwu ka ụwa meghee ma loda m na ebe obibi m.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
